evidence.title: ReCoG: Reciprocal Co-Evolution for Multimodal Graph Learning

summary: A novel approach called ReCoG (Reciprocal Co-Evolution) has been proposed to enhance multimodal graph learning by leveraging reciprocal evolution between modalities. The method aims to improve performance in tasks requiring the integration of diverse data types.
title: Researchers Introduce ReCoG: A New Framework for Multimodal Graph Learning
